execution_blocker: The host-side hard top-area policy and complete matched-control harness must be implemented and verified before a formal execution SHA can be frozen.
hypothesis: With the Stage A repair operator frozen, a dense action-specific benefit score selects repair locations that improve held-out segmentation more than random, mask-entropy, and generic current-error risk scores at the same activated area and decoder compute.

calibration.use: select the locked spatial area budget

validation.use: checkpoint selection and held-out Stage B decision

teacher_target.name: signed_dense_always_on_bce_reduction
teacher_target.baseline_logits: M0 low-resolution selected-mask logits from the unchanged first decoder
teacher_target.repaired_logits: M_all low-resolution selected-mask logits from the same episode with the frozen operator active at every feature-grid location
teacher_target.feature_grid_resize: area interpolation from decoder-logit resolution to the spatial-head grid
teacher_target.gradient_contract: M0, M_all, the frozen operator, SANSA, SAM2, and adapters are detached; gradients update only the spatial head
teacher_target.interpretation_limit: This is a dense proxy for the local benefit of an always-on repair, not an exact per-feature-cell causal effect.

spatial_head_training.best_checkpoint_rule: highest validation B2 mIoU at the preregistered 0.25 area budget; exact ties choose the earlier epoch

hard_area_policy.training_gate: soft sigmoid gate is permitted only while optimizing the dense score
hard_area_policy.locked_evaluation_gate: hard deterministic top-area selection on the post-memory feature grid
hard_area_policy.budget_selection_rule: Choose the smallest budget whose B2 calibration mIoU is within 0.2 point of the maximum B2 calibration mIoU over the frozen grid.
hard_area_policy.validation_rule: Report every frozen budget, and use only the calibration-selected budget as the Stage B decision row.

matched_controls.teacher: clamp(BCEWithLogits(M0, Y), 0.0, 1.0), area-resized to the spatial-head grid
matched_controls.fairness: same spatial-head architecture, evidence, initialization policy, train episodes, optimizer, seed, epochs, and checkpoint rule as B2; only the teacher target changes

matched_controls.purpose: dense-teacher proxy upper bound at matched area

primary_metrics.primary_selection_effect: B2 - mean(B3 seed 0, seed 1, seed 2) at the calibration-selected area budget
primary_metrics.primary_specificity_effect: B2 - B4R at the calibration-selected area budget
primary_metrics.additional_specificity_effect: B2 - B4E at the calibration-selected area budget

bootstrap.method: paired episode bootstrap over the 600 validation episode identities
bootstrap.random_control_aggregation: average each episode's B3 metric over the three frozen random seeds before bootstrapping

required: B2 - B0 paired mIoU and FB-IoU
guardrails_and_diagnostics.area_tolerance: The selected cell count must equal K for every non-baseline row and episode.
guardrails_and_diagnostics.full_area_sanity: At area budget 1.0, B2, B3, B4E, B4R, B7S, and B8S must reproduce B1 masks and aggregate metrics exactly.
guardrails_and_diagnostics.quality_guardrails: At the selected budget, B2 FB-IoU must not be more than 0.2 point below B0, and B2 worst-decile episode IoU must not be more than 0.5 point below B0.

pass_to_stage_c: The calibration-selected area budget is less than 1.0.
B2 - B0 is at least +0.5 mIoU point or its paired 95% bootstrap confidence-interval lower bound is greater than 0.
The paired 95% bootstrap confidence-interval lower bounds for B2 - mean(B3), B2 - B4E, and B2 - B4R are all greater than 0.
All quality, area-matching, provenance, and full-area sanity guardrails pass.
drop_stage_b_and_stop_exp_001: B2 has a non-positive point effect versus B0 at the selected budget.
B2 has a non-positive point selection effect versus mean(B3), B4E, or B4R at the selected budget.
The calibration-selected budget is 1.0, so the learned spatial score provides no spatial selection.
A preregistered quality guardrail fails and the failure is reproduced after a provenance-preserving rerun.
inconclusive: Every required point effect is positive but one or more required confidence intervals include 0 and B2 - B0 is below +0.5 mIoU point.
A required matched control, hash, immutable artifact, or per-episode output is missing.
A software or environment failure prevents a complete matched comparison.
revise_as_new_experiment_id: Continuing requires changing the frozen operator, teacher definition, spatial-head architecture, area-budget grid, data protocol, primary metric, or decision threshold.
stage_decision.scope_limit: A Stage B pass authorizes Stage C design and implementation only. It is not an EXP-001 KEEP decision and does not establish episode-level action-value routing.
